notes.title: DUM Justice Delivered 💥 A Limited Time Event Wrap Up
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Crewmates![/p][p][/p][p]Just because [b][url="https://schellgames.com/blog/dum-justice-3d"]the Vigilante Role is here to stay permanently[/url] [/b]doesn't mean we can't do a cheeky little recap on the DUM Justice Limited Time Event! We LOVE to share data and insights with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's start with some gameplay stats...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/3cbe11b44a793f90eb4fc588784f187a6db16b8c.png"][/img][/p][p]The Vigilante Role grants a Crewmate the ability to Kill other beans — be it the Impostor or fellow Crewmates. However, it seems a majority of Vigilantes didn't go on a justice-fueled rampage. 💢 Of all the deaths during the Limited Time Event, 63.46% were done by Impostors and [b]only 36.54% were performed by Vigilantes[/b]! ⚖️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/465be89be209bf1428444f8dedf177cf498fbf78.png"][/img][/p][p]Whether brought on by evil or well-intentioned justice, the number of unalivings during the DUM Justice event went wild! ☠️ [b]Over one million beans were killed! [/b]That's a lot of bones! 🦴[/p][p][/p][p]45% of these kills happened in lobbies where only one death occurred. So, that's either some really great deductive work 🔎... or speaks highly of Vigilante precision! 🔭 Alternatively, only 23 matches during the entire event period saw nine bean deaths in the same match. 🤯 Now THAT's stealth skill![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/c7304afc3de0e4d203ec8e89c7c82d4461b2d465.png"][/img][/p][p]Looking at color preference, it's not too shocking that 🔴 Red remains the most used Bean. We've seen this since essentially the beginning of time.[/p][p][/p][p]And yet... look how close ⚫ Gray is on taking the lead! Could it be possible for a color popularity upset after the Critical Cargo event?! 😱 We'll have to find out.[/p][p][/p][p]Obligatory #JusticeForBrown as well. 🤎 We're rooting for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/6a6a94a9739b03c92a9d2cd90b1091605059c020.png"][/img][/p][p]On the note of popularity, we're seeing some pretty expected results for the most used cosmetics as well:[/p][list][*][p]Red bean ❤️[/p][/*][*][p]Fedorable Hat 🎩[/p][/*][*][p]Git Gud Gloves 🕹️[/p][/*][*][p]Suited Up Skin 👔[/p][/*][/list][p]Clearly the majority of our Crewmate player-base are distinguished, dignified, and fashionable gamers. Who would've guessed?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/e358704defa6d34a1eaf0e2ea943400eeb2725a0.png"][/img][/p][p]Keeping on topic, all five of the Vigilante-themed cosmetics performed fairly well. Most notably, the [b]Caped Crewsader[/b] skin was the SECOND most used during the event, only losing out to the [b]Suited Up[/b] skin. It's giving 💵 billionaire philanthropist secret identity by day... Vigilante hero by night vibes. Right? 🦇[/p][p][/p][p]Rank 32 and Rank 44, for the [b]Vigilante Mask: Year One[/b] and [b]Vigilante Hood[/b] hats respectively, may not seem too popular... but consider this: if you exclude all of the free hat options, they instead come in at Rank 2 and Rank 11! Curious what the most popular hat would be instead? It's the [b]Plagued[/b] mask! ☣️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/b21d7295dcc3310fbf1b3a6ccd9c32f417a81905.png"][/img]
We can't wait to see how these stats will change when we scan-alyze the [b][url="https://schellgames.com/blog/critical-cargo-owners-manual"]Critical Cargo Limited Time Event[/url][/b]! 📦Especially with all of the exciting ✨ [b][url="https://schellgames.com/blog/critical-cargo-among-us-3d"]Weekly Cosmetic Drops[/url][/b] ✨ planned throughout the event — [i]new items drop every Thursday[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]Stay suspicious, Crewmates![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Scan with a Plan 📡 Critical Cargo is Now Live
notes.notes: [p]Scan you believe it? Critical Cargo, our new Limited Time Event (LTE), has officially come to [i]Among Us 3D: VR[/i]. Expect an all new mechanic 📡 along with a new role ✨, new game mode 📦, and new cosmetics 🚀 as you engage in behavior that is simply Scan-dalous. [/p][p][/p][h2]New Mode, Mechanic & Role[/h2][previewyoutube="59ebBtKIOGE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Get ready for [b]Critical Cargo[/b], a special mode available exclusively on the Skeld II. This mode introduces a brand new role: the ✨ [b]Critical Crewmate[/b] ✨. Protect these beans at all costs! If all of the Critical Crewmates get killed by the Impostors, the entire Crewmate team loses — regardless of how many Crewmates remain! ☠️[/p][p][/p][p]How do you know if someone is a Critical Crewmate? 🤔 Easy*! All beans have been equipped with a handy B.E.A.N.S. Suit Scanner with a reliable* "[b]Scan[/b]" ability![/p][p][/p][p]🔎[i] *Note: Scans aren't always reliable and may produce inconclusive results, making things not necessarily "easy."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]How does the Scanner work? 📡 After completing a set of tasks, Crewmates will gain the Scan ability. Scan a Bean next to you and one of three results will appear, indicating a Crewmate ([i]yay[/i] 🥳), try again ([i]boo[/i] 😞), or Critical Crewmate/Impostor ([i]aaahhhh[/i] 😱). Complete additional tasks for more Scans.[/p][p][/p][p]Impostors in this mode are more dangerous than ever. Even though they don't have the Scan ability, the Impostors are able to see a general status of every bean from the beginning! 😲 If someone seems to know way too much about roles around the Emergency Meeting table… that's your Impostor. Probably. 😅[/p][p][/p][p]Want to know even more? Check out [url="https://schellgames.com/blog/critical-cargo-owners-manual"]the Owner's Manual[/url] for this new mode![/p][p][/p][h2]Introducing Weekly Cosmetics! 💅[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/e9ad680b6ced92b6f65f558c9b823345d8b4e516.png"][/img][/p][p]If you love customizing your Bean, this LTE might be the best time to find the fit you've been looking for. Two new bundles are now available, including the basic [b]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000[/b] and the deluxe [b]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 9001[/b] upgrade. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Quick Fun Fact:[/b] [i]Every Bean starts Critical Cargo mode with a Scanner, replacing any other Hat cosmetic. However — you can purchase the golden B.E.A.N.S. Suit 9001 model scanner to replace the basic grey version to show off in the new mode (and after)! [/i]✨[/p][p][/p][p][b]Disclaimer:[/b] [i]Wearing the B.E.A.N.S. Suit 9001 Scanner does not increase the probability of conclusive scans or alter gameplay in any way. Other than making you look super elite and special. [/i]⭐ [/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/b21d7295dcc3310fbf1b3a6ccd9c32f417a81905.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/8a288a4c492c17fe280fa01dc25d0e7b2670cda4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/fa28cd17293305dce4f2f5407d694f18299a8978.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/25464e876e2d318ca0fc07281a3f2e31b8db190b.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Starting today, we will also be introducing 📅 [b]Weekly Cosmetic Drops[/b] 💅 into the [i]Among Us 3D: VR[/i] in-game store. notes.title: Your B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Owner's Manual
notes.notes: [p][b]Welcome, valued Crewmate, to the future of interstellar accountability! [/b]We've received your order for [b]Critical Cargo[/b], and expect your delivery to take place on [b]July 31, 2025[/b].[/p][p]You are now the proud owner of the Better Evaluation And kNowledge Suit, or as we like to call it, the [b]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000[/b]. This state-of-the-art, full-body attire is more than just a fashion statement; it’s your first and last line of defense against an early expiration in electrical.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/9807fdbc3f074cf65f36068d0a341a022e9648a5.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Unboxing your B.E.A.N.S.[/b][/h2][p]Upon unboxing your B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000, you should find:[/p][list][*][p][b]One (1) Skin: B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Suit: [/b]Available in any color you want, as long as it's grey.[/p][/*][*][p][b]One (1) 1 Pair of Gloves: B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Gloves: [/b]Perfect for rewiring, refueling, and redirecting blame to another.[/p][/*][*][p][b]One (1) Hat: B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Scanner: [/b]Attaches to your visor. Do NOT try to detach it. You'll just break it, and returns take forever in space.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/3e33979e7654058591fe96ef620d4e17616d3516.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Powering Your Suit (It's Basically PJs with Sci-Fi Bits)[/b][/h2][p]Putting on the B.E.A.N.S. Suit is as easy as jumping into your favorite onesie. The advanced, patent-pending fabric will automatically contour to your bean-like physique. Yes, your butt looks great.[/p][p]The Scanner will then magnetically affix itself to your cranium with a satisfying clunk. What is it adhered to? Don't worry about it.[/p][p]Your B.E.A.N.S. Suit starts with zero (0) charges and must be manually [b]powered by completing tasks[/b]. Subsequent task completion will supply additional scans, allowing Beans to Scan to their heart's content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/36b6954328a612ff78bb09baae9abdb5561b9889.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Using Your Scanner (No, It Doesn't Display Power Levels)[/b][/h2][p]Forget fumbling with handheld devices! The B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 features a state-of-the-art, head-mounted scanner for optimal, hands-free suspicion. It's science, but for your face.[/p][list][*][p][b]Charge your Scanner.[/b] Do your tasks. No, we’re not just yelling at you to get a Crewmate victory. Our patented technology grants a Crewmate one full Scan per each complete set of tasks completed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Choose a "Friend."[/b] Look directly at the Crewmate you find most suspicious. Maybe they took the last donut.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Activate the Scanner.[/b] Give the Scan button a firm, confident tap to execute your Scan. If you see double the Crewmates, you tapped too hard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maintain Visual Contact.[/b] Stare them down. Make it awkward. The Scanner needs a few seconds to penetrate from their suit to their very soul. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Receive Your Verdict.[/b] A final, definitive result will flash across your Scanner's Heads-Up Display. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/c268c056ffa98d2f57cc1cfeb34570e11e35477e.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Understanding Your Scan (Displayed Directly over the Suspected Party)[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/ad92ed7b658573750d6cc3dcb2ff7ce680cb660a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]CREWMATE[/b][/p][p]The Scanner reveals a calming light green Bean with a checkmark. Phew. This Bean is on your team. They are a certified, task-completing buddy. Now you can both follow each other around until one decides not to trust the other and you both lose.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/5bbc6b6c1299e530334a5e2ae3874b66e84fb32d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]INCONCLUSIVE[/b][/p][p]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Scans are 100% accurate. However, due to anomalies with shipping to your planet/starship via wormhole, your Scan may not work 100% of the time.[/p][p]An orange, blurred bean with a repeat signal means your Scanner needs to try again, and results are inconclusive. Time to do your tasks and recharge![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/6b5f4fbf73c400b797c96d827502913e2dd96e0b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/p][p]The Scanner displays a pink-hued Bean with an exclamation point. Jackpot! This Bean is either a Critical Crewmate OR an Impostor. [b]Critical Crewmates[/b] are V.I.B.s (Very Important Beans). Protect them. Even if they are really bad at tasks. Remember, if all of them are eliminated, it's an instant loss for the Crewmates![/p][p]Once you've figured out your Scan, it's time for your hero moment. Confidently call an Emergency Meeting and completely fail to explain your evidence. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/ed9a69f441aeeb8f31390d4ec524572eae8d8135.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]But Wait... I'm an Impostor[/b][/h2][p]Thanks for your honesty! A galactic patrol will be by shortly to assist in jettisoning you out of the nearest airlock.[/p][p]Impostors can don the B.E.A.N.S. suit, but [b]Impostors cannot Scan[/b]. Impostors may notice a weird product opportunity (we legally can't call it a glitch) where they receive a list of targets, including the Critical Crewmates, instead. The UI of the B.E.A.N.S. Suit Scanner will showcase indicators next to all seen beans, giving indication of their Crewmate or Critical Crewmate status likelihood.[/p][p]﻿﻿In other words, Impostors reap the benefit of the Scan functionality... [b]without needing to actually ﻿Scan[/b]. So, if someone seems to know too much too quickly, they probably need to be ejected! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/68ce73e7178b1a3c43ac8582153be4df6c4fb3c8.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Upgrade Your Fit[/b][/h2][p]All Beans start each round bedecked in their standard-issue Scanner. Suit 9001 Deluxe Edition[/b]! Our newest model comes with all the standard functionality, but with an incredible new color scheme (modified each cycle for the latest color trends) and, get this,[/p][p][b]A GLEAMING, GOLD* SCANNER[/b][/p][p]That’s right, [b]GOLD*![/b] Forged in the heart of a dying star, this golden Scanner does everything the old one did, but with unimaginable style. Convey an aura of authority and trust and make fellow Crewmates think, "Now there's a crewmate who invests in quality. They are definitely not the Impostor."[/p][p][b]Don't delay! Upgrade to the B.E.A.N.S. The Vigilante is no HERO, they're a MENACE!!![/p][p][/p][p]So, dear readers, I'm turning my call to you.[/p][p][/p][p]\[ Key Art ][/p][p][/p][h2]📸 GET ME PICTURES OF THE VIGILANTE! 📸[/h2][p][/p][p]That's right. [h2]AMONG US 3D IS NOW ON PC[/h2]

A brand new threat has entered the mix. Introducing: The Infected! In Tag Mode, it’s Infected versus Crewmates. The Infected try to catch and infect all the Crewmates to expand their ranks before the Crewmates can finish a set number of tasks. 
[list][*]Tag Mode can be accessed through matchmaking
[*]Minimum player count of 6 required for Tag Mode
[*]At game start, two players are chosen to be Infected[list][*]Two Infected at every player count
[*]Infected spawn randomly at fixed spawn options around the map[/list][*]Crewmates must complete a fixed number of tasks to win, Infected must infect everyone to win
[*]Crewmates always have 3 tasks available to them
[*]Whenever a Crewmate completes a task, a new task is assigned[list][*]Whenever a Crewmate completes a task, they receive a random power[list][*]Invisibility
— Makes the user invisible for a short period of time
— Can still be infected while invisible
[*]Detection
— Reveals all Infected on the minimap
[*]Guardian
—Places a shield on another Crewmate that protects the Crewmate from one infection (the infect action still goes on cooldown)
[*]Stun
— Stunning an Infected resets the timer on their infect ability
[*]Vent
— Allows the Crewmate to use a vent once, similar to the Engineer 
— A vented Crewmate will be booted out of the vent when the timer ends[/list][/list][*]Tasks for Tag Mode are separate from the tasks in Classic mode.[list][*]There are no common nor long tasks
[*]All tasks have only one minigame each[/list][*]Alterations to Polus Point for Tag Mode[list][*]Quarry and Specimen are inaccessible, the doors leading to them are locked (in O2, Lava Stabilizer and Dropship)
[*]All vents (except those in Quarry and Specimen) are connected in a single group.[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/7752619e39b7a19e2281331c4c8706e328598f66.png[/img]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
With the launch of Among Us 3D, we have a handful of bugs and issues that made their way into this build of the game. We are actively working to address these issues and encourage players to contact our support channels on any additional issues they may encounter.
[list][*]Performance on Meta Quest 2[list][*]Performance may be affected with multiplayer game modes, causing players to dip below 72 frames per second.
[*]This issue is most common while in Tag Mode and/or on Meta Quest 2 headsets.
[*]We have identified the core issue, and are working on an additional patch to directly fix these issues.[/list][*]Host Migration Issues[list][*]Players may be sent to the Main Menu instead of the lobby in the event that a host leaves the original lobby.
[*]Very rarely that player will need to reset their game if the Main Menu UI doesn’t appear.[/list][*]Invisible Sabotage Arrows[list][*]The visual indicators leading Impostors to Sabotages can sometimes display improperly or not at all[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png[/img]

notes.title: Ejecting and Reflecting on 2024 🎉
notes.notes:

[h2]⌛ A Year of Limited Time Events 📆[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/4368ffed5780f2bc30418132abb06fa0fba8aae7.png[/img]
2024 introduced Limited Time Events into the [i]Among Us VR[/i] pipeline, and [url=https://schellgames.com/blog/auvr-lte-wrapup]we're proud to have hosted six unique events[/url] throughout the past twelve months. From deception in the dark with 💡 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l2xDVNA1ozs]Lights Out[/url] ⚡ to wrangling up Impostors as the Deputy in our latest (and currently still running!) 🤠 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BYU_-SZmJLg]Round Up[/url] 🏜️, we've shaken up the [i]Among Us VR[/i] experience to keep things exciting and fresh — and continue to do so in the future!

[h2]💗 We Know About Popular ✨[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/d5cf2d981dfdf4253a0c88a1bf4322685ee707fc.png[/img]
It wouldn't be a Recap blog without diving into our favorite metrics! 🤓 Here's a handful of highlights: [list]
[*] The most popular bean color, as always, was Red. ❤️ Surprising no one. However, second place fluctuated throughout the year between 💙 Blue and Grey 🖤.
[*] 🤎 Brown continues to remain as the least used bean color. #JusticeForBrown 😭
[*] Impostors killed ☠️ over 6 MILLION Crewmates ☠️ over the course of the year, with 6.5% of those beans surviving less than 30 seconds. ⏱️
[*] Most matches experience either 1 - 2 or 7 -8 kills. ⚖️ The least common kill count during a match is four.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/c6156721801ae445d9206a10a8ffd23c013be0d6.png[/img]
Isn't it wild to think that this time last year, Gloves and Skins weren't available in your Wardrobe? [url=https://schellgames.com/blog/auvr-cosmetics]Cosmetic options to fully express and customize your Beansona have grown significantly[/url] since last year, and we're always excited to see which looks are your favorites.

[h3]🎩 Hats 👒[/h3]
[list][*] Of course, the most popular hat for beans continues to be the [b]Fedorable[/b].
[*] Lights Out mode introduced the first fully animated hat, [b]Overscoped[/b], in February 2024. This hat ranked in at the second most popular Limited Time Event exclusive hat of the year.
[*] So, which event-exclusive hat was the most popular? The [b]Vigilante Hood[/b] beat, slammed, and served over the competition as the most popular Limited Time Event focused headpiece.
[*] On the opposite side of popularity, the [b]Powdered Person[/b] vampire wig from the Limited Time Pack: Trick Picks was the least popular hat of the Wardrobe. Whomp whomp.[/list][h3]🧤 Gloves 🥊[/h3]
[list][*] Gloves debuted in June 2024 as part of the Limited Time Pack: DUM Duo and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971550/Among_Us_VR__Glove_Pack_Catch_Deez_Hands/?curator_clanid=42287672]Glove Pack: Catch Deez Hands[/url] sets.
[*] The [b]Git Gud Gloves[/b] quickly rose to the top of hand cosmetics and has stayed there since. It's noteworthy to clarify that the d-pad and buttons don't actually allow the input of codes or cheats... but that would be pretty sick.
[*] Lowest on the list, again from the [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/LRHUEmk0ero]Limited Time Pack: Trick Picks[/url], sits the [b]Undead Ends[/b] vampire gloves. We're honestly surprised at how much you beans seem to not like vampires. They don't even sparkle! Come on![/list][h3]👔 Skins 🥼[/h3]

[*] Currently, the [b]Howdy Duty[/b] Deputy Skin — from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297980/Among_Us_VR__Limited_Time_Pack_Round_Up/]Limited Time Pack: Round Up[/url] set — reigns as couture champion.[/list]

notes.title: Sound the Alarms 🚨 Limited Time Event — Containment Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
We cannot [i]contain[/i] our excitement about this one, beans.

[previewyoutube=vAS0xUrqT64;full][/previewyoutube]
In the latest [b]Limited Time Event: Containment[/b] mode, a new threat enters the mix: the map itself! Entire wings go into lockdown on their own, locking you in to confined quarters with impenetrable door lasers. 🔒 The lights go haywire, impacting your visibility and ability to keep an eye on that conveniently placed vent on the wall... 🚨 Sabotage events initiate on their own, meaning the map itself could be the cause of the crew's demise... ☠️ This is no longer simply a matter of Crewmates versus Impostors — it’s Bean Against Environment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/40d0d352e972fee93aed19d6de2512435dc8dc8c.png[/img]
Two rooms have also been added into the Containment map: the upgraded Hangar and the brand-new Vault!

Right at the heart of the map, the Hangar serves as an immersive starting point for game lobbies. Our Devs are especially proud of the immense sense of scale and openness this upgrade room offers — so, don't be shy about looking up and around. 👀 The joys of 3D!

The Vault, on the other hand, combines some of our favorite aspects of any room: a designated Security Cams corner close to ventilation (💨 [i]it's for the air quality, of course. no other purpose![/i]); a high-security vault filled with the crew's most precious cargo ([i]seriously, this collection is impressive![/i] ✨); an all new "Take Inventory" task to verify the contents of our mini-safe ([i]who left the combination right on the front?![/i] 🤐); and a convenient tunnel that was dug out to lead into the janitor's closet ([i].... wait a minute. WHAT?! [/i]😱)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/b005d93af0180143656ccd899a7a8cb0924b7d7f.png[/img]
It wouldn't be a Limited Time Event with a few new additions to the Wardrobe.

Our first featured set, the [b]Limited Time Pack: Containment[/b], allows you to wrap your bean up in black and yellow tape with the 🚧 Hazard Wear Hat and Hazard Wear Gloves. 🚧 CAUTION: The contents of this set are extremely fashionable and may be dangerously deceptive! 🚨

We're also getting down and dirty with 🧽 [b]Combo Pack: Squeaky Clean![/b] 🧽 This pack adds SIX new cosmetics to wash away your fashion woes: 🧢 two VR-Exclusive hats 🧹, 💩 two returning hats 🧻 from the original Among Us, and 🫧 two handy gloves ⚪ for your bean.

[previewyoutube=ACZdzgxtxI8;full][/previewyoutube]
It's time to get locked in to the lock down, beans! The Limited Time Event: Containment lasts [b]until September 10, 2024[/b].

Stay suspicious!

notes.title: Pulling Down The Mask 💥 Limited Time Event #3 Highlights
notes.notes:
No more mystery. No more shadows. It’s time to pull down the mask, beans.

Now that the dust has settled from the 💥 Vigilante’s DUM Justice, we’re here to break down and kick out some numbers for you! ⚖️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/d811815ff4196603d0cb6f53a75ba9b88bf73f32.png[/img]
Let’s start with the obvious — you all love the Vigilante bean. 💙 And, let’s be real… who wouldn’t? 

Throughout the duration of the Limited Time Event — DUM Justice, the Vigilante Hat ranked within the Top 13 Most Used Hats. It even peaked in the Top Five on June 15, beat only by the Trapp’d, Greh, Safety Second, and (of course) Fedora! 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/1e6a304e5b8b4353fbae764c9a1d183ddaf21094.png[/img]
The Vigilante love showed its face in terms of gameplay win ratios, as well. 📈 A majority of games won in the event’s DUM Justice mode were won by eliminating all Impostors. 🥊 Now, we know that not ALL Impostor kills were done by the Vigilante (ejections are still a thing! ☄️), but… we suspect you Vigilantes simply enjoyed having the Kill power in your little bean hands.

This is even MORE evident with the fact that the average lifespan of a bean during the DUM Justice event was between thirty seconds to a minute! ☠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/7100dc2327300e630c3037b10b34c44c3e7268c5.png[/img]
Red continued to dominate the color competition. 🥇 However, we did see Grey and Purple knock down Blue and Green respectively when comparing to our previous Limited Time Event — Infection. 🌯

The bottom six colors remain the same as before, so we continue to root for our Yellow, Lime, and Brown underdog beans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/9195ba98f1956e64ed1631c20b242c2148779f00.png[/img]
Now that we’ve put the Vigilante hood away and our Limited Time Event — DUM Justice has served its time… it’s time to look forward. 👀 We simply cannot [b]contain[/b] our excitement to share the next event with you very soon! 🚨

Stay suspicious, beans!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png[/img]

notes.title: Suit Up for DUM Justice! 💥 AUVR’s New Limited Time Event Has Arrived
notes.notes:
Greetings, beans! We’ve got another exciting update to share with you today on the [i]Among Us VR[/i]-front.

Turn on the Bean Signal, Commissioner! 🔦 It’s a bean! 🫘 It’s a betrayal! ☠️ It’s… DUM Justice! 💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/469895e8e9d8de6d698b4e58fc8f25c2db1f99cb.png[/img]
Our third Limited Time Event is here! 🎉 Starting NOW, our ⚖️ DUM Justice event ⚖️ will be live and waiting in the alleys, on the rooftops, and wherever danger strikes! ([i]Okay, it’s really just in the game. But, it’s fiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiine.[/i]) Become vengeance beansonified with the introduction of a brand new role: [b]The Vigilante.[/b] 💥

Vigilantes join the Crewmates with their own Kill ability! But with Engineers venting right alongside the Impostors… will they put a stop to the right bean?! 😱 A Vigilante’s Kill ability can be performed on ANYone — and roles won’t be revealed during ejection either. So, are you about to vote out the Impostor who killed Yellow in Electrical… or are they actually the Vigilante?! 😰

🕸️ Remember: With great power comes great responsi-bean-ity! 🕸️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/b1feaafe31dfd6da023d5b37a306f18313bf5cc4.png[/img]
But the Vigilante isn’t the only one taking matters into their own hands — We’re also [b]hand[/b]ing out another brand new feature to the game: GLOVES! 🧤

You’ve been proudly and perfectly parading around the plethora of hats available in your Wardrobe… and now it’s time to expand your options. Get a grip on three brand new hand cosmetics with our new Glove Pack: Catch Deez Hands OR you can mask-up as our DUM Justice Vigilante bean with the Limited Time Pack: DUM Duo that includes both Vigilante Hood and Gloves! (Both packs are available on the store as an additional purchase.)

Our team is hard at work filling your Wardrobe with options so you can perfectly outfit your beansona, so we hope you’ll be excited to see what’s next!

[previewyoutube=0uRkWfi9rGY;full][/previewyoutube]
And finally… alongside all of the crime-stopping chaos, we’ve added another highly requested tool to your utility belt with this update…

✨ Security Cams are now operational in the Skeld II! 📹

Take control of various cameras’ live feeds to scope out and monitor areas all around the Skeld II. 👀 But don’t get too comfortable — with your back turned to an inconspicuous vent… you might just become easy prey. ☠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/4e3381be51c68403f60e536d8091c036835e96cf.png[/img]
The [i]Among Us VR[/i] Limited Time Event: DUM Justice runs today (June 13) through July 9, 2024 — so don’t miss your chance to take justice into your own hands and advance your cause today! No matter the collateral damage. 💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/d1d8f7acd328a7922c0501081c1e78c88e83ba63.png[/img]

Alongside the limited time Infection Mode introduced with this Limited Time Event, we also sprinkled a new map into the mix: the Mess Hall.

We’re proud to say that the Mess Hall was a burning success 🔥 and was easily the most popular map throughout the duration of the Infection Event. In fact, Infection Mode alone was played almost three times more times than matches on the Skeld II! Wild! 🤯

🎉 And, as an added bonus, we’re keeping the Mess Hall around — but only just for a bit longer. So be sure to cook up some Crewmate chaos and don’t burn your chicky nuggies before it goes away for good. 🐥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/43318a17e55572840441e53c0207b728aceb11a0.png[/img]

In the epic battle of Zomburrito versus Chefs, we’re seeing some interesting data from our beans… 🧮

On one hand, the 🌯 Zomburrito cosmetic was worn almost 2.5 times more often than the 🧑‍🍳 My Name Chef toque [i](both hats were included in the Limited Time Hats: Mess Hall DLC pack)[/i], clearly showcasing the favorable preference for that flavor profile. 🧂 Meanwhile, on [url=https://discord.gg/amongusvr]our official [i]Among Us VR[/i] Discord server[/url], we asked our beans to choose between the Chef or Zomburrito. Chefs triumphed over the Zomburritos by doubling their numbers! So… what’s going on here, beans?!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/3cc27cd063960850eaaa048fda3b00fc87115c01.gif[/img]

We’re glad to see that the fun and excitement of our Infection Event spread like the Zomburritos and your comments and feedback continue to fill the plates of our hearts. 💗 But for now, we clean up the mess made by these deliciously deadly Zomburritos and prepare for our next event… coming joon — sorry, sune! notes.title: 🍽️ Taste the Perfection of Infection in AUVR’s New LTE!
notes.notes:
We hope you came hungry, beans! We’ve got an extra serving of mayhem prepared for our Limited Time Event #2 — Infection Event!

[previewyoutube=D3sLfe6tQpI;full][/previewyoutube]
This LTE introduces [b]Infection Mode[/b], where beans are divided into two teams: Chefs and Zomburritos. 

Chefs are kind of like your Crewmates: innocent, dedicated to completing their tasks, and super stylish with matching toques 🧑‍🍳. But, look out, Chefs… you’re not alone. 😱 Just around the corner, hidden in the bathroom, waiting in the freezer… infected Zomburritos await! Just where did they come from? How did they come to be? No one knows… All we do know is that whatever they have is extremely dangerous and contagious! ⚠️

As a team, Chefs must complete ten of their tasks before they are caught and infected by a Zomburrito. Meanwhile, the Zomburritos crave more numbers and seek to contaminate the Chefs! Once infected, Chefs will mutate into Zomburritos themselves and need to help convert the rest of their old companions into delicious monstrosities as well! Will the Zomburritos take over or can the Chefs finish their tasks in time?! ⏲️

Did we mention that all of this takes place in a new map…?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/2ffcb8d7f092c14f2640683c50a60143834468f2.png[/img]
Feast your eyes on the Mess Hall!

We’ve shaken some spice on the Polus Point map you’ve grown to love… and come up with a new recipe for disaster fun! 🧂 Add in a large dash of industrial corridors, a splash of dead ends, a sprinkle of cave-ins, TWO bathrooms, and our secret ingredient — a brand new room: the kitchen! 🍳

We expect you to fry chicky nuggies to crispy perfection with the new deep fryer task. 🍗  Marvel in awe of the donut-making machine. 🍩 Take inventory of the supplies stored within the giant freezer 🧊, just don’t get locked in… especially with an Impostor! Oh wait… is that a vent?! 😱

notes.title: 💡 It’s LIGHTS OUT for Among Us VR!
notes.notes:
Listen up, Beans! We’ve got some news, and can’t keep you in the dark any longer…

Our very first [b]Limited Time Event[/b] in [i]Among Us VR[/i] starts NOW!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/14e202118e4da87e1e673bc82da19b23566c09e7.png[/img]
[h3]🤔 What is a Limited Time Event?[/h3]
We’re excited to announce our newest take on game updates: [b]Limited Time Events[/b]! 

During these events, players will be able to hop into brand new gameplay experiences, ranging from new tasks and roles to game modes that change the rules of a match! Each event will revolve around a special “theme” — so we hope you’ll enjoy dressing up your beans to coordinate.

These themed events will only be available for, [i]you guessed it[/i], a limited time. You’ll only have a few weeks to experience the themed chaos and shenanigans — so, don’t miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/8aaadb6720ee5671367a4d3f16a8652b7974fb1e.png[/img]
[h3]💡What is new in the “Lights Out” Event?[/h3]
Prepare for an epic battle of 💡 light and darkness 🕶️! Our first event will introduce two new major changes to the [i]Among Us VR[/i] experience — [b]Engineers[/b] and [b]Lights Out Mode[/b]!

In [b]Lights Out Mode[/b], players will face off in a dynamic tug-of-war event. The Crewmates have all become [b]Engineers[/b] and can utilize their expertise in vent navigation to quickly get around the map and finish tasks — before the Impostor(s) wipe them out and it’s lights out for good! All the while, the lights and the Engineers’ vision will adjust depending on the current state of the match! 💡

Just like in the original [i]Among Us[/i], 🛠️ [b]Engineers[/b] 🛠️ are Crewmates with the special ability to use vents — just like an Impostor! This role will not only be the primary focus of the [b]Lights Out Mode[/b], but will be available within the Custom Lobby Settings to add into the mix for standard matches as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/9805f864dc59aa0b8ee92c14754a1121c53ad619.png[/img]
[h3]🥽 I love this! How can I show off my love for the “Lights Out” Event?[/h3]
Additionally, we’re excited to introduce the first fully-animated hat — 🥽 [b]Overscoped[/b] 🥽 — to commemorate this Limited Time Event! Available as an additional purchase, the Overscoped hat serves ⚡ big engineer energy ⚡ to your bean with its oscillating scope and steampunk goggle aesthetic. But, take note! The Overscoped hat will only be around for the duration of the “Lights Out” event — so act fast! ⌚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/8708b525a27dc00a1b1f68eb9d0c1b446f9e8851.png[/img]
The fun begins ✨ [b]TODAY[/b] ✨ — so get hopping in for a Lights Out ad-vent-ture!

Stay suspicious, beans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/86145143db6f93d7ff33b58d1bc7b02d28597cfb.png[/img]
⚠️ Forget anything you may or may not know about our Beta Channel, as it is henceforth be known as [b]B.E.T.A. (Biweekly Experimental Test Area)[/b] — yes, we worked hard on this name … and it might change again. Don’t judge us, we like acronyms.

What does this mean? It means that recently we have and will continue adding in features and content to the B.E.T.A. that are more spontaneous and, well... [i]untested[/i]. Things may get weird, unpredictable even, but either way, things are about to get exciting! 👀

✅ Here is an FAQ from our dev team on the latest B.E.T.A. Channel update!

[h2]🚀 B.E.T.A. Channel FAQ Update 8.31.23 - Join In-Progress Matches and Spectate! 🚀[/h2]

[b]Q: What’s in the B.E.T.A. Channel this time?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]We’re so glad you asked! The big news is that we’ve added the ability to join in-progress matches. It’s progress for in-progress sakes, Beans!

[b]Q: How does joining in-progress matches work?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]This is the best part! You won’t need to do anything differently. If you click on “Quick Match” from the main menu and there are no pre-game lobbies with open player slots available, you will be placed into an ongoing match as a spectator.

[b]Q: What does it mean to be a spectator?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]As a spectator, you can only observe the match. Nobody can see or hear you, not even ghosts or other spectators. This way, you can get an impression for the character dynamic of the group that is playing and either choose to stick around until the next round starts (at which point you will join as a regular player) or find a different match that better suits your preferences.

[b]Q: But aren’t systems influenced by the very act of being observed?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]You’re thinking of quantum mechanics. This is [i]Among Us VR[/i]. Common mistake.

[b]Q: What else is there to know about joining in-progress matches?[/b]

[b]A:[/b] If you choose to re-matchmake, the system will attempt to place you in a new match — keep in mind that in B.E.T.A. Channel, because there are generally not as many players, you may return to the same one again. However, this new way of matchmaking should make it much much easier to get into a match with the settings of your choice, even if there are few matches of that type available. 

[b]Q: What should I do if I find a bug or an exploit?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]Oh you probably will! You should laugh at it, exploit it, and talk about it in our [b]#open-beta-testers [/b]channel on Discord — we love when players test things out with us! That being said if you’re having issues playing the game because of a bug in the B.E.T.A. Channel, please do not contact support. Just switch back to the LIVE channel (instructions in our pinned post).

📝 [b]An evergreen survey for B.E.T.A. Channel feature feedback [url=https://forms.gle/9gxxzt6veat1HqR16]can be found here.[/url][/b]

[i]Please note: [/i]Features or bugs found in the B.E.T.A. are unfinished products and in active development. They may also never see the light of day beyond the B.E.T.A. channel. 

[b]Q: Cams/Pets/Roles/etc. when?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]No comment.

[b]Q: Is this update coming to the LIVE build?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]We can’t promise anything, but definitely keep an eye out. Perhaps you should spectate and see! 

[b]Q: Anything else I should know about the new B.E.T.A. update?[/b]

[b]A. [/b]Fantastic question! With Meta’s increased focus on the Quest line, and many Rift players already moving to the SteamVR platform instead, it’s no longer sustainable for our engineers to continue supporting the Oculus Rift store. That being said, we want to continue to provide the best experience possible for the majority of our active players, and unfortunately this means fully ending Rift Store support, which will take place on [b]Wednesday, October 4, 2023.[/b]

[b]Players on the Rift Store will be the first to lose updates on the B.E.T.A. Channel.[/b] If you have previously purchased [i]Among Us VR[/i] on the Rift Store and would like to continue playing via Steam (including the B.E.T.A. Channel), please [url=https://schellgames.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1/group/1/create/56]contact us through player support at this form[/url] with your Rift proof-of-purchase, and we can discuss your options!

[b]Q: Have any more questions?[/b]

[b]A: [/b]For more on the new B.E.T.A. Channel, visit [url=http://discord.gg/amongusvr]the [i]Among Us VR[/i] Discord[/url]. [i](It’s also just a pretty cool place in general… so, you know… you should join regardless!)[/i]

As a reminder, any feature requests or feedback unrelated to the B.E.T.A. can still be directed to this [url=https://schellgames.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1/group/1/create/16]player support feedback form[/url] and the evergreen survey for B.E.T.A. Channel feature feedback [url=https://forms.gle/9gxxzt6veat1HqR16]can be found here[/url].

✨🚀 B[b]ONUS:[/b] [i]Among Us VR[/i] developers will be featured on Schell Games’ [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SchellGames]September Schell Games 360 livestream[/url]. Keep your eyes peeled for more details across our channels next week!

It’s all the spectating, Beans!

Stay Suspicious.

[b][url=https://www.innersloth.com/among-us-vr-%f0%9f%9a%80-new-map-teaser-vote-on-the-name/]Back in February[/url], we revealed a new map is coming to [i]Among Us VR[/i] later this year.[/b] We also tasked you to help us make 📜📜 Crewmate History 📜📜 by voting as a community for the name of said map 🔎. Well, you voted and the results are in. 🧮

The official name for [i]Among Us VR[/i]'s new Polus-inspired map has been decided, and we’re excited to reveal it to the universe (and our fans)!

But first, let’s talk about how busy you’ve been, honestly. [b]Around 14,000 of you voted[/b] for your map name choice, and [b]over 80% of you provided extremely helpful insights[/b] about your experience and desires for the game going forward — thank you, beans!.

notes.title: Patch 4: Hot Out the Oven! 🔥🍕
notes.notes:
Greetings, Crewmates!

Patch 4 Time! Get ready to update your spacesuits and embrace an upgraded Skeld II — some in-game changes have arrived. Our finest Crewmates have installed a new mode to your lobbies — the power of customization! That’s right: Custom Lobby Settings, [b]the thing you’ve all been asking for[/b], is now at your fingertips (or is it bean-gertips?)!

[h2]✨✨✨ Introducing Custom Lobby Settings! ✨✨✨[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/cec89fe3986bbd96fc0d7a6f0b3f612f9fc41631.png[/img]
Over 9 billion customization configurations are being added to [i]Among Us VR[/i] with this upcoming feature. We’re not even joking. One of our devs did the math. By hand. Using an abacus. Our team is truly dedicated. 😭😭😭

These settings will allow the host of a lobby to adjust the pace, balance, and general rules of how a match plays out! Want to favor the Crewmates? Go ahead! Think Impostors deserve an edge? We’re a bit skeptical… but do you, my friend. ⚖️ [b]We’ve even added a little indicator to give you a bit of insight on just how much you might be skewing the default game balance.[/b] ⚖️This balance indicator shows how your personal settings compare to the default ones, but your mileage may vary — ie, we’re not perfect, so don’t be upset if it deceives you a little bit. 🤐

Crewmates with experience in the original [i]Among Us[/i] will recognize many of the familiar Custom Lobby Settings, but we’ve thrown in [b]some fun new exclusive-to-VR treats[/b] as well. For instance, you can enable “Hands Visible” at all times so that faking a task requires Impostors to not only stand near the proper station, but mime doing the task as well. It’s straight devious.

Here’s the full modifier list:[list]
[*] Number of Impostors
[*] Kill Cooldown
[*] Hands Visible
[*] Chat Enabled
[*] Crew Vision
[*] Impostor Vision
[*] Number of Emergency Meetings
[*] Number of Long Tasks
[*] Number of Short Tasks
[*] Visual Tasks
[*] Taskbar Updates
[*] Report Bodies
[*] Discussion Time
[*] Voting Time
[*] Anonymous Voting
[*] Ejections Show Role
[*] Door Sabotage
[*] Sabotage Cooldown[/list] 
[h2]✨✨✨ Billions Of New Ways To Play! ✨✨✨[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/5255123b26e9674c52ae24d380cbfda9bdc69f0f.jpg[/img]
Given the above list, the team has put together a few experimental customization setups below to get your bean noggins churning. But, of course, feel free to create your own special rules to play how YOU want! If you do discover any specific combos you find enjoyable, [b]let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/amongusvr?utm_campaign=amongusvr_discord_patch4_blog_post&utm_medium=post&utm_source=discord&utm_content=&utm_term=patch 4][i]Among Us VR [/i]Discord![/url][/b] We just might feature your combo on our social media channels. 👀

[b]🔎🔎 Where’s The Proof? 🔍🔍[/b]
Without skewing the scales too much, it can be fun to play with a little bit more vagueness and scarcity of information. Put your social deduction skills to the ultimate test by wiping away any shred of evidence.[list]
[*] Hands Visible: Always
[*] Chat Enabled: During Meetings
[*] # Emergency Meetings: 1
[*] Visual Tasks: Off
[*] Taskbar Updates: Never
[*] Anonymous Voting: On
[*] Ejections Show Roles: Off[/list]
[b]🫣🫣 Conceal and Prowl 😈😈[/b]
Numerous Crewmates. One Impostor seeking them out. And absolutely nothing stopping a brutal takeover except clever hiding skills and a speedy task list completion.[list]
[*] # Impostors: 1
[*] Kill Cooldown: 10 sec
[*] Hands Visible: Always
[*] Crew Vision: Min
[*] Impostor Vision: Long
[*] # Emergency Meetings: 0
[*] # Long Tasks: 0
[*] Report Bodies: Off
[*] Door Sabotage: Off
[*] Sabotage Cooldown: 40s[/list]
[h2]✨✨✨ PIZZA TIME ✨✨✨[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/abeddd274a46086753e66d5c253629131517f5f2.png[/img]
All of these options are available to Crewmates with the game for the price of FREE. That’s great value! But, that’s not all! Update now, and we’ll also throw in a delicious slice of pepperoni pizza… onto your head!

[b]The Pizza Time hat[/b] is now hot and fresh in your Wardrobe.

And, if that doesn’t satiate your hunger for hats… the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0YdEpMosxAs&utm_campaign=amongusvr_steam_patch4_community_post&utm_medium=post&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=patch4][b]Hat Pack: Accidental Favorites[/b][/url] DLC is available today for $4.99 USD — featuring some go-to toppers from the original game: [list]
[*] [b]Note 2 Self[/b] (because who can keep track)
[*] [b]MoRawk[/b] (go hard, beans)
[*] [b]Third Eye[/b] (but can you see it all?)
[*] [b]Magical ‘Corn[/b] (oh, you fancy)
[*] [b]Peeled[/b] (apparently, potassium is important)[/list]
[h2]✨✨✨ Into the Unknown We Go! ✨✨✨[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/934329bde611e9e0d7c37907f1230bfe6fbd0c27.png[/img]

We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and would like to extend another full course thank you to all of our players. Together, we’re checking off our Task Lists and making [i]Among Us VR[/i] the best VR Space Bean Game of all time!

In case you missed it, we recently revealed a new course directive for the Skeld II: an unnamed location on Polus! For more details about the next map coming later in 2023 and how YOU can vote to help name it and become a part of Crewmate history, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p5ymVVMS6WE &utm_campaign=amongusvr_steam_patch4_newmap_community_post&utm_medium=post&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=patch4]check the link here[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 2: The Big Fix
notes.notes:
Greetings, Crewmates! 

[h2]✨✨✨ The BIG Fix is here! REJOICE! ✨✨✨
[/h2]
We’ve been actively listening to your feedback, and our Task List was starting to pile up. So, we’ve got a doozy of an update for you. Hold onto your visors, beans — it’s a big one!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42287672/2697eee32774c3a3adb31252a7a9be4226dd04d2.png[/img]

On top of the general improvements to connection issues, overall game stability, and a safety feature defaulting players’ usernames to display by default instead of color, we’ve updated the game with sixty bug fixes to issues that you reported!

For our technical-minded or just-really-naturally-curious beans, we’ve shared a full breakdown of our Patch 2 fixes in our Patch 2 Release Notes, which you can also find [url=https://discord.gg/amongusvr]on our Discord server[/url]!

But, we’ll summarize a few of the highlights for you. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42287672/0d6ae82d7af2622ba79892754c5944fc55c99c57.png[/img]

First on our list is a focus on 📶 repairing connection issues 📶! Players will have fewer experiences in the "black void” between matches and no more invisible beans.

We’ve also fixed the pesky issue where the game would tell you your birthday was invalid. 🎂 We see your birth as being valid, and now the game does, too! 🎂 Formatting of the date will now be correctly validated, and, as a bonus birthday gift, you won’t keep getting pestered to re-enter your birthday every time you return to the menu.

A number of visual bugs, 👓 both in-game and with the UI 👓, have been addressed. The holomap in Admin has been upgraded to actually work properly. Hands, shadows, corpses, Impostors… Stuff you shouldn’t be seen can now be seen, and stuff you shouldn’t be seeing will now be NOT seen.

Don’t worry, Impostors. We haven’t left you out of the updates either! 😈 We’ve fixed issues so Impostors will no longer get stuck in the vents or in a mysterious black void when an emergency meeting is called or a match ends. 😈

On top of all this, we’ve also updated random issues with tutorial progression, blind spots, task (minigame) behavior, and a plethora of miscellaneous situations! Yes, we busted out the word plethora — that’s how you know we’re serious.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42287672/466b6f18dbb4e869e12b9c53d8bc4d652592cf4d.png[/img]

Now that we’ve completed all these tasks, the real fun begins! ✨✨✨ Be sure to check out our recently shared [url=https://www.innersloth.com/?p=3987]2023 Roadmap[/url] to get a sneak peek at what we’ve got in the pipeline in the coming year. We know [i]we’re[/i] excited — and hope you’ll be, too!

Stay suspicious, beans!

notes.title: Patch 2 release notes
notes.notes:
[b]Stability Refactor Overview[/b]
— Connection/Black Void issues 
— Players not being able to join lobbies 
— Players not being fully visible 
— General connection issues as it relates to network traffic
— Host migration to no longer cause broken states (Works for both Meta & Steam)

[b]Display Name[/b]
— New Users
— — Hide Username will be unchecked for 16+
— — Under 16 will not have the option and default to color 

[b]Specific Bug Fixes[/b]
CONNECTION
— Updated networking logic to reduce data sent and improve performance and reliability in general
— Made major changes to handling player connecting and spawn in to reduce players getting stuck in a black void while attempting to join a game
— Adjusted connection logic to reduce the number of times player will experience timeout exceptions
— Improved host migration process so it's much less common for players to get stuck in a black void during the migration
— Fixed issue where player could join a lobby and be invisible to other players

AGE CHECK
— Fixed age check prompt to correctly validate dates based on MM/DD/YYYY regardless of location
— Fixed age check being repeated asked upon returning back to the menu rather than just once when starting up the game 

BLIND VOLUMES
— Adjusted blind volume positions on the Skeld to avoid accidental blindspots in various locations 
— Fixed an issue where dying inside of a blindbox would disable it

VISUALS
— Fixed anti-grief volumes would disable after a few seconds when clipping through a player during the pre-game lobby 
— Fixed shadows occasionally not appear on players when they first spawn into a lobby
— Fixed issue where hands would briefly flash in a different location when releasing a button after an interaction
— Fixed issue where all hands would appear briefly when reporting a body before returning to the lobby
— Fixed issue where corpses from previous rounds and games would continue to remain visible for players even when starting a new game
— Fixed issue where previous victim's name would be displayed when reporting a new body
— Fixed a minor blip where the Impostor would briefly reappear in front of a vent after exiting another vent 
— Tightened transitions between cutscenes 

MINIGAMES
— Fixed an issue where Impostors would have a yellow highlight around non-completed tasks from a previous game
— Fixed an issue where getting killed within a minigame would not restart the minigame unless you moved in and out manually 
— Fixed players would snap to tasks in the Cafeteria during emergency meetings
— Fixed Upload Data task in Admin never resetting if leaving the Admin room while task was still active 
— Fixed Calibrate Distributors not correctly resetting visuals when leaving before completing the task 
— Fixed Align Engines issue where stepping away from the task could change your progress
— Fixed Chart Course continuing to play a sound even when disengaged with the task 
— Ghosts are no longer able to interact with the O2 sabotage 
— Fixed light sabotages not always correctly turning off in the lobby if timed correctly with a transition 
— Fixed an issue with Reactor sabotage would not resolve if using the trigger/grip button as the host 
— Fixed a rare issue where successfully completing tasks would not win the game for the Crewmates 

TUTORIAL
— Fixed issue where Crewmate death notification would not appear in tutorial 
— Fixed issue where footsteps could continue to play as a ghost in the tutorial 
— Fixed rare cases where you could never fix the O2 sabotage 
— Fixed critical sabotage not appearing on the map while active 

UI
— Settings menu can no longer be toggled on during cutscenes 
— Fixed issue where player reticles would disable early when interacting with multiple overlapping interaction areas 
— Fixed player chat and other UI being visible over the blinders 
— Fixed issue where placeholder text could be seen on the age verification UI 
— Fixed disconnected players still remaining visible on meeting interfaces during an emergency meeting 
— Fixed vote button remaining highlighted after voting when using both hands at the same time 
— Fixed minimap occasionally flickering after stopping or moving into a new room 
— Fixed an issue where the wardrobe button would remain highlighted if clicked repeatedly before it opens 
— Fixed countdown timer not re-appearing if a player had left and rejoined a lobby during a previous countdown 
— Fixed an issue where the holomap would show a player in the Upper Engine position even when no one was there 
— Fixed an issue where the holomap in Admin would not update in real-time with players 
— Fixed an issue where the Crewmate’s body would not be in the correct location if getting killed never leaving the cafeteria 
— Fixed an issue where the buttons on the start screen would make incorrect SFX sounds when hovered 
— Fixed an issue were the countdown timer would be obscured while in the wardrobe 

VENTING
— Fixed vent bars not appearing at the correct position while looking out of the vent in Cafeteria
— Fixed an issue where player can end up in a black screen when venting when match ends
— Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in a vent when transitioning while an emergency was called
— Fixed a rare issue where the Imposter's collision box would stop working if the game ended while in a vent

MISC
— Fixed rare crash for the game if the HMD device was not found when starting the game 
— Fixed issue where footsteps could play a bit too often even when not moving 
— Fixed issue where player could walk through locked lobby doors if they moved quickly enough when returning back to the lobby 
— Fixed rare issue where leaving the invite player menu on Oculus Quest could cause the controller to rumble indefinitely 
— Fixed issue where no timeout error popup would appear when being disconnected by the host in some instances 
— Fixed host migrations not working on Steam with voice clients 
— Fixed being able to set your Snap Turn setting to 0 degrees 
— Added notification if the game is unable to save any data because the system is out of disk space 
— Added notification when a game window is not focused and is not accepting player input
— Added missing localization for internet not found message

notes.title: Patch 1 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Crewmates! 

Our first patch is live today, so we wanted to provide more transparency on what exactly it’s doing, what we’re doing, and what lies ahead for you!

Here’s the TL;DR recap:
[quote]👾👾👾 [b]BUG FIXES[/b] 👾👾👾
This update may be small, but there’s a super-mega-jumbo patch in the coming weeks!
✨✨✨ [b]NEW OPEN BETA CHANNEL[/b] ✨✨✨
Want to be a Beta Tester for our bug fixes before our next patches even go live? Opt in!
🎩🎩🎩 [b]NEW HAT PACK[/b] 🎩🎩🎩
The holidays came early! New Festive Favorites hats are available now.[/quote]
If you want the deets, keep reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/3757786c2d5a7bac602f09d00ed1a10ccb35a0af.png[/img]

[h2]👾👾👾 [b]BUG FIXES[/b] 👾👾👾[/h2]
Being 100% real with you all right now: this is a very small update we already had built-in and waiting to go after launch. The big features of this update nullify some sneaky cheater tactics; we added some fixes to exploits noticed during our Beta Tests.

I know what you’re thinking. “[i]That’s it?! Are you even listening to our complaints?![/i]”
Let me assure you, we hear you all loud and clear. And we’re hard at work making adjustments to the game to address your biggest concerns. In fact — the next patch is coming soon (in mid-December!), and we assure you it’ll be worth the wait!

But, before we push these changes into the main game… we thought you might want to help us test…

[h2]✨✨✨ [b]NEW OPEN BETA CHANNEL[/b] ✨✨✨[/h2]
… so, we’re adding an Open Beta channel that you can opt into and live experience our bug fixes! With how integral our original Beta Testers were in helping us identify issues and testing… with thought this would be a win-win solution!

Opting into the Open Beta channel will allow you to play on a different build of the game where the Dev Team is actively working on addressing known bugs. Meaning, you may just get a sneak peak at some fixes before they go completely public — in fact, our first priority test will revolve around an issue we’ve seen a number of you reporting: decreasing the wait time to fill public lobbies [i](specifically when changing from private to public!)[/i].

Here’s how to opt in:[olist]
[*] Right-Click [i]Among Us VR[/i] in your Library and select Properties
[*] On the BETAS tab, change the dropdown from None to Beta
[*] You may need to exit (not minimize) Steam and reopen to trigger the update [/olist]This is also totally optional~! So no pressure!
Bug fixes will be implemented into the base game after we’ve solidified they are working. So, those staying in the regular build will be assured the most stable option — and it’ll be updated accordingly!

[h2]🎩🎩🎩 [b]NEW HAT PACK[/b] 🎩🎩🎩[/h2]
A brand new wave of your favorite hats have now converted into the realm of VR! Celebrate the season with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849900/Among_Us_VR/ ]Hat Pack: Festive Favorites DLC[/url] — available now!
[quote]🎁 Presents Dude
🎁 Can’tdy Cane
🎁 Oh, Dear, Rain
🎁 Lit Up
🎁 Frosted
🎁 Toy Dude[/quote]
Additionally, [i]all[/i] Crewmates are being [i]gifted[/i] with the Gift Wrapped hat! See what I did there?
Your presence in our community is a present, so we thought you should be aptly rewarded as such. So, we hope you’ll enjoy this little token of our appreciation.

[previewyoutube=8vj0wVsXNHM;full][/previewyoutube]
We appreciate you hanging in there with our bug fixes and continuing to send in your feedback! [i]Among Us VR[/i] will continue to grow before 2023 hits and well beyond.
Stay safe, have fun, and don’t be suspicious!


[b]Kutakuma[/b]
Schell Games, [i]Sr. Community Marketing Manager[/i]

notes.title: Among Us VR Week One Recap: It's A Big One!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Crewmates!

Thank you for a ✨✨✨ [b]GLORIOUS LAUNCH DAY![/b] ✨✨✨

We hope that you’re enjoying all of the deception, lying, killing, and pleading your innocence on the Skeld II.

It has officially been one week since launch (can you believe it?!), so we wanted to provide some clarity and address some common topics we’ve seen come up following launch hype.

[i]This may be a little lengthy, but I assure you, it’s worth the read.[/i]
But, here’s the TL;DR — 

[quote]🚀🚀 [b]Enjoy Our Official Discord [/b]🚀🚀
Join your fellow beans here [url=https://discord.gg/amongusvr?utm_campaign=auvr_post_launch_discord_meta_steam&utm_medium=&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]on our official server.[/url]
📊📊 [b]Use The Official Support Form[/b] 📊📊
Having in-game issues? [url=https://schellgames.com/support/among-us-vr.?utm_campaign=suport_form_steam_meta_review_support&utm_medium=&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]Report them here![/url]
⏳⏳ [b]Stay Patient In Private-to-Public Lobbies[/b] ⏳⏳
It takes time to fill lobbies. Sorry! We’re working on it.
💩💩 [b]Report Toxic Players[/b] 💩💩
Report them. Report them! [url=https://schellgames.com/support/among-us-vr.?utm_campaign=suport_form_steam_meta_review_support&utm_medium=&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]REPORT THEMMMM~![/url]
🎂🎂 [b]Enter Your Birthday Without Any Issue[/b] 🎂🎂
Swap the Month/Day if you’re having problems. We’re working on it.
📅📅 [b]Our Year One Roadmap Is Coming… Soon[/b] 📅📅
More is coming~! We’ll share more details when we can.[/quote]
Alright — Now if you’re still sticking around for the lengthy test, here are the deets:

[h2]🚀🚀 [b]Enjoy Our Official Discord[/b] 🚀🚀[/h2]
We’re excited to gather all of our little beans into one convenient chili pot. Okay, not really. It’s more like a spaceship. With handy channels for reporting bugs, finding lobbies to join, sharing your creative endeavors, or just interacting with each other and our dev team, [url=https://discord.gg/amongusvr?utm_campaign=auvr_post_launch_discord_meta_steam&utm_medium=&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]the official [i]Among Us VR[/i] Discord[/url] is truly the place to be for all of your [i]AUVR[/i] shenanigans.

[h2]📊📊 [b]Use The Official Support Form[/b] 📊📊[/h2]
We are seeing so many of you coming in with great feedback and reports… and we don’t want to miss these in the shuffle. So, we’ve whipped up [url=https://schellgames.com/support/among-us-vr.?utm_campaign=suport_form_steam_meta_review_support&utm_medium=&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]an official, multipurpose Support Form[/url] where you can report bugs, bad player behavior, or submit your content feedback and suggestions to us formally!

We have support agents responding to tickets as fast as possible. As of right now, you can likely expect a message back within one business day (in most cases, WAY sooner than that!) [i](exceptions occur, naturally, but we think these are pretty good numbers!)[/i]

On top of this, we have a list of some known bugs and issues listed [url=https://www.innersloth.com/?p=3612&utm_campaign=known_game_bugs_steam_meta_community_post&utm_medium=post&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]on our official blog here[/url]. So, be sure to check it out for more guidance, if you need it!

[h2]⏳⏳ [b]Stay Patient In Private-to-Public Lobbies[/b] ⏳⏳[/h2]
We're seeing crewmates have to wait as long as ten minutes for their private matches to become public after they click the button. It might seem like it's never going to work, but once they go public they'll fill up fast and keep filling up fast, so sit tight. Use the time to make plans or grab a soda in the cafeteria.

We’re working on making this switch happen faster, but can assure you the process [i]is[/i] working and more players [i]will[/i] pop into your lobby if you remain patient.

For a quick refresh, here's how to play a game with your friends: 
Create a private lobby by hosting a match and share the lobby code with your friends.
Once all of your friends have shown up, convert the lobby to a public lobby via the button on the lobby screen. 

Wait five to ten minutes ([i]cringe, I know…[/i]) for this change to go into effect, and then enjoy as multiple new beans pop into the cafeteria ready for deception!

[h2]💩💩 [b]Report Toxic Players[/b] 💩💩[/h2]
We hear you. We [i]also[/i] don’t want any kind of harassment, toxicity, or rule-breaking to occur in our game. So, let’s talk about how we can quickly and effectively stop this from happening in-game.

[h3]First: [i]Mute and Kick functionalities exist in the game. Feel free to use them.[/i][/h3]
You can find these options in the Players Tab (the little Crewmate icon by your mini-map!). After you click into the Players Tab, select the appropriate Kick or Mute icon next to the problematic bean (there will be a list of all players).

We also have [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VKoa7iMWEv0&list=PLINVNan6DCzp78u7dy_bUmynZ5Wrlzwrp&index=11&utm_campaign=youtube_moderation_video_store_post&utm_medium=&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]a really handy video[/url] on how to do this. I assure you, it’s easy!

[h3]Second: [i]Use the Report A Player features [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/4DE7-17AA-0E8B-C1AD?&utm_campaign=auvr_post_launch_community_post&utm_medium=&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=]on Steam's official platform[/url]![/i][/h3]

[h3]Third: [i]Please also submit a ticket using [url=https://schellgames.com/support/among-us-vr.?utm_campaign=suport_form_steam_meta_review_support&utm_medium=&utm_source=metasteam&utm_content=&utm_term=]our official Support Form[/url]![/i][/h3]
Be sure to include as much identifying information as you can, such as: time of the game; which region/server you were playing on; lobby code; their color or (preferable) username; description of their toxic behaviors

[h3]Fourth: [i]Be an example of the kind of player you want to see![/i][/h3]
This isn’t a “grow up” message, but rather a point to be nice and respectful. Sometimes a little patience, sincerity, and communication can go a long way! 
You can also choose to engage in Quick Chat Only lobbies. Here, you can use the preset Quick Chat text options OR choose to express yourself solely with your hands for a different form of shenanigans.

Additionally, we wanted to let you know that player safety is of the utmost importance for us and top priority. [b]We are actively working to improve our reporting process with goals to implement major improvements for early next year.[/b] Thank you for your patience in the meantime.

[h2]🎂🎂 [b]Enter Your Birthday Without Any Issue[/b] 🎂🎂[/h2]
Some players have reported issues with entering their date of birth when logging in. 

Basically, if you can’t submit your birthday, try flipping the Month and Date fields. 
So, if you’re a Capricorn with a January 15th birthday and the game doesn’t seem to like it when you enter 01/15/1997, try entering your date of birth as 15/01/1997.

We have a whole other list of other known bugs that we highly recommend you check out here! And, of course, if you experience anything, feel free to let us know using the official Support Form!

[h2]📅📅 [b]Our Year One Roadmap Is Coming… Soon[/b] 📅📅[/h2]
It’s cominggggggg. Prepare yourselves.

Again, thank you so much for joining us on this little adVENTure.
Stay safe, have fun, and don’t be suspicious!


[b]Kutakuma[/b]
Schell Games, [i]Sr. Community Marketing Manager[/i]
[i]Publicly endorsed by [b]pilarkey[/b][/i]
